caption: The drawing features a single knitted textile object resembling a long, cream-colored sock or stocking, arranged in an inverted “U” shape against a plain, off-white background. The upper portion of the sock is decorated with colorful, embroidered floral motifs, including a large blue flower, a red and yellow patterned shape resembling a tulip, green leaves, and a pink area suggestive of another flower or petal. The lower part of the sock is more plain, with the knit texture clearly visible and no additional colors aside from the cream of the textile. Toward the right tip of the sock, there is a dark brown rectangular patch, which appears to be either a heel or a repair. The background is otherwise empty except for a small handwritten label or signature in the lower right corner.
title: Wedding Garter
